theme: Dark Cinematic & Experimental (#0B0B10 base with Deep Purple -> Oxblood -> Black gradients)
context: Film lovers discovery tool with Letterboxd-adjacent moody aesthetic, liquid glass panels, glowing orbs, and hidden gem curation

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight font-serif text-slate-100
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight font-serif text-slate-100

visual_enhancers.radial_orbs: Floating blurred circular gradients (#581C87 & #881337) placed with absolute positioning, blur-3xl opacity-40 animate-pulse
visual_enhancers.poster_card: aspect-[2/3] rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-[1.03] hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-purple-900/40 hover:border-purple-500/30
visual_enhancers.nostalgia_overlay: Grainy sepia vintage filter effect with warm vignette and subtle scanlines when Nostalgia Mode is toggled ON
visual_enhancers.custom_cursor_glow: Subtle purple/crimson radial glow circle following mouse cursor on desktop viewport

layout_and_grids.hero_layout: Full width dark hero section with central cinematic typography, floating orbs, dot grid background, auto weather/context badge, and quick mood selector
layout_and_grids.movie_grid: grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6 lg:gap-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 py-8
layout_and_grids.controls_bento: Glassmorphism bento grid for Vibe Input, Mainstream-to-Obscure dial, Context badge, and Filter toggles

mood_chips.style: pills with soft border glass, selected state glows in purple/oxblood with subtle scale transformation

features: Hidden Gem badge with sparkle icon
LLM Mood Blurb in serif quote style
Where to watch streaming availability badges

controls.vibe_input: Large liquid glass input with search button & AI magic prompt hints
controls.obscure_slider: Mainstream (1) ↔ Deep Cut Hidden Gem (10) custom styled range slider
controls.context_badge: Live weather icon + local time + trending cultural event tag
controls.surprise_button: Surprise Me single card reveal modal with roulette animation

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure dark background #0B0B10 is used universally with liquid glass overlays
Implement dot grid background using pure Tailwind/CSS overlay on hero

Ensure all interactive elements have explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='mood-chip-nostalgic', data-testid='vibe-input', data-testid='slider-obscure', data-testid='movie-card-1', data-testid='modal-close-button')
Build hybrid engine with realistic mock fallback data plus direct backend LLM endpoint integration
Keep maximum 2 visual effects per screen to prevent over-clutter
Use Sonner for toast notifications when user copies vibe link or switches nostalgia mode
Integrate trailer view modal, where-to-watch tags, rating pills, and obscure-meter badge
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered plain layouts or Inter/Space Grotesk for main titles
Ensure high text contrast against dark backgrounds and semi-transparent glass cards
Always specify hover states with explicit text colors (hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10)
Do not add transparent backgrounds without backdrop-blur on dropdowns or modals
Add data-testid attributes to buttons, inputs, links, tabs, sliders, and cards for automated testing
